feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: Two children among six dead in plane crash
articles.summary: Divers have found the bodies of six people, including two children, after a plane crashed off the coast of Mississippi on Tuesday, according to the US Coast Guard.

articles.title: Donald Trump set to raise tariffs on 16 major economies
articles.summary: Donald Trump is set to raise tariffs on China, the European Union and several other countries, according to reports.

articles.title: Colombian police storm supermarket, freeing hostages and killing gunman
articles.summary: Colombian police have stormed a supermarket and freed at least 20 people who were being held hostage, killing one of the gunmen.

articles.title: Huawei guilty of plotting to steal trade secrets and bank fraud
articles.summary: Chinese tech giant Huawei, has been found guilty of conspiracy to steal trade secrets and bank fraud after a landmark trial in the US.

articles.title: Thomas Markle formally charged over child sexual abuse material
articles.summary: Thomas Markle has been formally charged on two counts of possessing child sexual abuse material in Los Angeles.

articles.title: China 'sentences official to death for spying'
articles.summary: China has sentenced to death an official who was said to have leaked state secrets to a foreign country.

articles.title: FA chair had to sign NDA to view FIFA documents on World Cup sell-off
articles.summary: Football Association chair Debbie Hewitt has now viewed some FIFA documents on the World Cup sell-off but had to sign a nondisclosure agreement, Sky News has learned.

articles.title: Morocco 'astonished' at decision to restore Senegal as Africa Cup of Nations champions
articles.summary: Senegal have been awarded the Africa Cup of Nations title after successfully appealing against the decision to strip them of it.

articles.title: Gisele Pelicot 'deeply shocked' as nude photos of her sent to media
articles.summary: Gisele Pelicot has said she is "deeply shocked" and "humiliated" after nude images of her were sent to the media without her consent to promote a new book about coercive control.

articles.title: Deadly fire at confectionery factory kills 24 as rescuers search for dozens still missing
articles.summary: A deadly fire that tore through a confectionery factory in Indonesia has claimed the lives of 24 people, with 34 others still missing.
